name: VyaparSetu Pro
prompt:
Build a vibrant, colorful, Play-Store-grade commercial Shop Billing, Udhar Khata, QR Scanner & PDF Invoice app named VyaparSetu Pro. Use rich emerald, royal blue, amber and violet gradient cards (never plain black).
1. TAB 1 (#view-1 Home): Colorful Today's Sales Rs., Pending Udhar Rs., Total Bills cards, a live 7-day Sales Chart (Chart.js), and Quick Action cards that open #view-detail sub-pages via FactoryNav.openDetail().
2. TAB 2 (#view-2 Billing): Add item name, qty, price & discount (zero NaN), a button to Scan Product QR using Html5Qrcode camera, Generate Bill button that saves via FactoryDB.recordTx(), opens FactoryUI.receipt() with PDF Download + Confetti, and a "Send Bill on WhatsApp" button (https://wa.me/?text=...).
3. TAB 3 (#view-3 Khata & Stock): Customer Udhar/Jama list filterable by #app-search-bar, tapping any customer opens #view-detail with full ledger & "Add Payment" button; plus #floating-cta (+) opens Add New Customer modal.
4. TAB 4 (#view-4 Profile & History): Shopkeeper Name & Mobile saved in Supabase, live Transaction History from FactoryDB.getTransactions(), Download Monthly PDF Report button, and Log Out.
